purpose: functional verification of a private Git remote cloned with a node credential on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a private remote is cloned with the node's credential, which the server saw
the token is nowhere in the guest, nor in the clone's config
a remote outside the credential's prefix is sent no Authorization header
a wrong token is refused with 502 before anything boots

detail.refused with a wrong token: http://127.0.0.1:33149/private/app.git: git clone: fatal: could not read Username for 'http://127.0.0.1:33149': terminal prompts disabled

cases.name: a node with no credential for the remote is refused with 502

detail.refused with no credential: http://127.0.0.1:33149/private/app.git: git clone: fatal: could not read Username for 'http://127.0.0.1:33149': terminal prompts disabled
